reviewedBy: Claude (Opus 5), session 57b768fe, reading the /collect draft output with Jacob Kennedy
review: EMPTY INCLUDE BECAUSE THIS IS A 19% SAMPLE. The capture holds 168 of 882 products. A non-empty include list can only name types somebody has SEEN, so on a sample it silently drops every type in the unseen 80%. That is the failure mode nobody notices: the shelf fills, it looks plausible, and two thirds of the catalogue is missing.

The cost of the empty list is three junk rows: two 'Additional Payment Link' and one 'AI Credits', which are checkout mechanisms rather than products and will render as cards with prices. Three bad rows in eight hundred is a rounding error against dropping seven hundred good ones. If an exclude list ever exists, they are the first entries.
The Gift Card is refused by the classifier without help.
Everything lands in the Workshop, which is correct: laser engravers, 3D printers and their parts.
